notes: Cross-verse split with DEU.16.5. Both verses write a quantifying construct noun over a noun with an English *of* between them; 16.5 gives that *of* to the rectum and leaves the quantifier its own word, 16.21 kept it on the quantifier. Rule 19's first sentence assigns the relational expression to the nomen rectum, and its `כֻּלָּם` paragraph forbids reading such an *of* as part of an English quantifier. `כֹּל` now takes *of any kind* — the leading *of* under rule 33, the supplied generic *kind* under rule 31 — and `עֵץ` takes *of tree*.
